environment.description: Same ASP.NET Core 7.0 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ALB has a custom listener rule that applies a token-bucket rate limit of 2 requests per 10-second window per source IP on the /api/Export/* path group, returning HTTP 429 before the request reaches the container. The ECS task uses an ephemeral read-only root filesystem with a mounted tmpfs at /tmp/staging (noexec,nosuid,size=10M). The task IAM role has no S3 or filesystem permissions beyond the container. The Fargate platform version 1.4.0 runs with a default seccomp profile that does NOT restrict symlink/symlinkat syscalls. Container runs as UID 1000 (non-root) with fs.protected_symlinks left at kernel default (1 on Amazon Linux 2023 but the tmpfs mount is owned by UID 1000 so the protection does not apply to files owned by the same user). The critical control is the ALB fixed-response rule: the TOCTOU race between writing to staging and the attacker replacing the staging file with a symlink requires multiple rapid sequential requests (minimum 3-4 within a 2-second window to win the race), and the ALB throttle ensures only 2 requests per 10 seconds reach the application, making the race window unexploitable in practice.

config.fs_protected_symlinks: kernel default (1) but same-owner tmpfs negates it
